description_en: Detaches a protected object from a mitigation policy
description_zh: 防护对象取消关联防护策略
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp detach-from-policy --policy-type l3 --ip-port-protocol-list PortRange=80-90 Ip=47.118.172.000 Port=80 Protocol=tcp --port-version 2 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachFromPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The type of the policy. Valid values:

- **default**: The default mitigation policy.

- **l3**: An IP address-specific mitigation policy.

- **l4**: A port-specific mitigation policy
parameters.help_zh:
策略类型。取值
- **default**：表示默认防护策略
- **l3**：表示IP防护策略
- **l4**：表示端口防护策略
parameters.name: policy_type

element_fields.help_en: The IP address of the protected object
element_fields.name: ip

element_fields.help_en: The port of the protected object
element_fields.name: port

element_fields.help_en:
The protocol type of the protected object. Valid values:

- **tcp**: Transmission Control Protocol.

- **udp**: User Datagram Protocol
element_fields.help_zh:
防护对象的协议类型，取值：

- **tcp**：表示传输控制协议。
- **udp**：表示用户数据报协议
element_fields.name: protocol

element_fields.help_en:
The port range of the protected object.

> This parameter is supported only by port-specific mitigation policies
element_fields.help_zh:
防护对象的端口范围。
> 仅端口防护策略支持
element_fields.name: port_range

parameters.help_en:
The version of the port-specific mitigation policy. Valid values:

- If you do not specify this parameter, the default Surf deep packet inspection (DPI) engine policy is detached.

- If you set this parameter to **2**, the new Stream DPI engine policy is detached.

> This parameter is supported only by port-specific mitigation policies
parameters.help_zh:
端口防护策略版本，取值：

- **不填**：解绑默认 surf 防护引擎策略。
- **2**：解绑新版 stream 防护引擎策略。
> 仅端口防护策略支持
parameters.name: port_version
